title: The cyclotomic character is trivial on a finite-field fixing subgroup
statement: Let p be prime and Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ. There exists an intermediate field F of Ω/ℚ, finite-dimensional over ℚ, such that ExtCitation.cycloChar p σ = 1 in (ZMod p)ˣ for every rational algebra automorphism σ of Ω that fixes F pointwise.
lean_statement: ∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime], ∃ F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F ∧ ∀ σ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ, σ ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → ExtCitation.cycloChar p σ = 1
